Proposes an approach (Skill Dreaming, PR-driven evolving repository skill library for coding agents); evaluated on SWE-bench Pro/Verified and six repositories against skill-learning baselines and ablations

Skill Dreaming (no version). Baselines: base mini-swe-agent without skills, append-only skills, Trace2Skill, Learning to Commit, SkillLens, CODESKILL, Socratic-SWE; BM25/dense/hybrid retrieval listed as baselines

Repository-specific skill library: skills written by a fixed-weight LLM writer from predefined templates (when it applies, how to implement, how to validate), in five families (PR Detection, PR Construction, Feature Implementation, Maintenance Completion, Skill Evolution); each skill keeps supporting PR records, repository-version info, dependencies, related skills; PR-record index with labels usable/repairable/outdated/irrelevant/unsafe. No requirements specification

Per request (Algorithm 1): (1) PR record construction: feature localization, retrieve/segment historical PRs, classify, construct candidates by reuse/repair/synthesis, verify with tests; (2) skill generation and alignment (Add, Update, Specialize, Extend, Conflict, Supersede, Keep); (3) skill-guided implementation: retrieve bounded skills, inject into actor, implement code + tests/docs/config, verify, bounded repair; record outcomes for next round

Agent: mini-swe-agent; models Claude Opus 5, Sonnet 4.6 (Anthropic SDK). Criterion: official harness resolution. SWE-bench Pro: (a) Base + mini-swe-agent + Opus 5: 0.79. Baseline. (b) Skill Dreaming + mini-swe-agent + Opus 5: 0.88. Works; cost Not stated. SWE-bench Verified (Table 3/4, resolved / safe / Surf. F1): (c) Base + Opus 5: 0.83 / 0.83 / 0.62. Baseline. (d) Skill Dreaming + Opus 5: 0.92 / 1.00 / 0.74. Works; cost Not stated. (e) Append-only (ablation) + Opus 5: 0.88 / 0.94 / 0.72. Works. (f) Trace2Skill + Opus 5: 0.76 / 0.78 / 0.60. Does not work. (g) Learning to Commit + Opus 5: 0.72 / 0.67 / 0.64. Does not work. (h) SkillLens + Opus 5: 0.90 / 0.61 / 0.59. Partly. (i) CODESKILL + Opus 5: 0.79 / 0.56 / 0.46. Does not work. (j) Socratic-SWE + Opus 5: 0.91 / 0.72 / 0.64. Partly. (k) Base + Sonnet 4.6: 0.77. Baseline. (l) Skill Dreaming + Sonnet 4.6: 0.79. Partly. Cross-repo (Table 5, Opus 5, TS base -> ours): Click 0.72 -> 0.83, Black 0.53 -> 0.60, Rich 0.90 -> 1.00, HTTPX 0.80 -> 0.93, Arrow 0.58 -> 0.75, Agents 0.50 -> 0.70. Works. Efficiency (Table 12): Skill Dreaming TS 0.93, 26,894 tokens, 36.0 s/task vs SkillLens 0.61, 14,300 tokens, 32.9 s. Cost partly (+88% tokens). Ablations (Tables 10-11): full TS 0.93 vs no supersession 0.67, no stale filtering 0.72, neither 0.78, append-only 0.89 (skill filtering setting)

Tasks: SWE-bench Pro subset and SWE-bench Verified subset (historical base commits, only prior PR information used to avoid leakage); six repositories with historical PR split into skill-construction and evaluation sets. Configurations: base agent, skill-learning baselines, ablations, with Claude Opus 5 (and Sonnet 4.6 for Verified). Baseline: base mini-swe-agent without skills. Held constant: agent (mini-swe-agent), model within comparison, retrieval settings (top-8, threshold 0.20, text-embedding-3-small). Acceptance tests: official benchmark harness. Repetitions: Not stated. Human intervention: Not stated

Skill Dreaming best resolved rate on Verified (0.92 vs Socratic-SWE 0.91, SkillLens 0.90, append-only 0.88, base 0.83) and Pro (0.88 vs 0.79); Sonnet 4.6 +2 points; Safe rate 1.00 and Surf. F1 0.74 highest; Algn. 0.44 below Learning to Commit 0.49 and Socratic 0.45. Cross-repo TS gains 0.07-0.20. Tokens +88% vs SkillLens. No significance tests or variance
